subject.title: [Feature]: Per-bot context isolation in multi-bot Feishu groups - only record context when mentioned

question: Should Feishu requireMention groups keep today’s pending skipped-message history by default, add an opt-in mention-only/per-bot context policy, or change the default behavior for multi-bot groups?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the permanent behavior changes public Feishu config and a documented group-history contract, so automation should not choose the compatibility tradeoff alone.

options.title: Add Opt-In Feishu Context Policy
options.body: Introduce a Feishu-owned context policy such as mention-only or exclude-other-bots, keep current defaults, and require schema/docs/tests plus live multi-bot proof.

options.title: Change requireMention Semantics
options.body: Treat `requireMention: true` as mention-only context by default, accepting a documented compatibility break or migration plan for users who rely on skipped-message context.

options.title: Defer To Generic Target Attribution
options.body: Keep Feishu unchanged until the broader group target-attribution work at https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/56692 defines a cross-channel contract.

recommendation.title: Add Opt-In Feishu Context Policy
recommendation.body: Introduce a Feishu-owned context policy such as mention-only or exclude-other-bots, keep current defaults, and require schema/docs/tests plus live multi-bot proof.
